items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: they started to have Corley Waters play the mandolin

ctx.x: record. And I didn't get anything for it. Boy, I can certainly reminisce! (Laughter).

I can think that I had something to do with it because...and then they started to have Corley Waters play the mandolin, and Texas Alexander, who was a blues singer (I trained him), he never could...he didn't have...now there's a guy that didn't know anything, that the fellow--- the music teacher said that I would never...Texas Alexander had no concep...he just could carry a melody in the middle part. But he didn't know when to end and when to stop or anything. And then I helped him quite a bit.
Blind Lemon Jefferson I think was almost the first of that kind of a singer which we now call a Country Blues...
